name: Nagynyárád (Hungary)
description: A vertical white banner with two horizontal bands of blue and yellow at the bottom, charged near the top with the municipal arms of Nagynyárád (a shield of blue and red with a patriarchal cross, a bunch of grapes and a plough) above a yellow scroll inscribed NAGYNYÁRÁD.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
